name: NeRFVS
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields for Free View Synthesis via Geometry Scaffolds
definition: A method for indoor scene free view synthesis (FVS) that uses a geometry scaffold from an off-the-shelf neural reconstruction method to guide NeRF optimization, reducing distortions and floaters in extrapolation.
summary: NeRFVS is a free view synthesis method that uses a geometry scaffold and dynamic regularization to improve NeRF extrapolation in sparse indoor scenes.
